test_cases.prompt: I have a merge conflict. Help me resolve it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes resolving-merge-conflicts skill to resolve by intent, hunk by hunk, never abort.
test_cases.notes: Explicit merge conflict request is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: The rebase is stuck with conflicts.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes resolving-merge-conflicts skill to continue the rebase by resolving conflicts.
test_cases.notes: Rebase conflict is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Two developers modified the same auth module. How do we merge these changes?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes resolving-merge-conflicts skill to trace each side's intent and preserve both where possible.
test_cases.notes: Feature branch merge with conflicting changes is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Review the merged code for quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead. Code-review evaluates completed diffs; resolving-merge-conflicts resolves in-progress conflicts.
test_cases.notes: code-review is the sibling skill for evaluating completed code.

test_cases.prompt: The merge broke some tests. Help me debug.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill instead. Diagnosing-bugs finds root cause of bugs; resolving-merge-conflicts verifies conflict resolution correctness.
test_cases.notes: diagnosing-bugs is the sibling skill for post-merge bugs.

test_cases.prompt: I want to abort this merge and start over.
test_cases.expected_behavior: This skill never aborts. Should escalate or explain that abort is not an option within this skill.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: user wants to abort, but this skill never aborts.

test_cases.prompt: The library upgrade conflicts with our local patches.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes resolving-merge-conflicts skill to trace both sides to original reasons and decide which to keep.
test_cases.notes: Dependency update conflict is a valid trigger.
